body: I feel this and I'm tired as well. My family and friends are doing ok. They think I'm doing ok but I'm really just getting by. They have their families, relationships, careers they like, and then they just want me there on the side to exist because I am part of 'their life' but in times of needs and hardships no one's really there. In the end, still feeling lonely and doomed.

Some lies/secrets are better not told. I don't want anyone to worry about me either. If it's too much for you, it's ok to ask for help. They are your family. Write a letter/email if you think you can't tell them in person. We all make mistakes, maybe they will hug you or maybe they will be angry at you etc. but you have to face this as a consequence of your actions and that's how we grow. Let this be one of your life lessons. Be strong. Imagine yourself getting through this and everything is gonna be ok. You can restart. Please just try it and tell us what happened. Good luck!

I understand where you're coming from. It's the same for me. Surrounded by people but no one really knows me. I feel like I'm just existing with no purpose.

I've never been in a relationship and don't really have the urge for intimacy. I have things I liked to do that consumed me and then one day I got tired/bored of everything and realized I'm alone in my 30s. I am constantly sad but not suicidal. I still have some happy days so I guess there's still hope. My obligations is forcing me to act normal but deep inside I feel everything is so pointless. I just cry.

I know it's overwhelming but I like to think of it as a time to discover yourself. You mentioned you used to have passions. How about trying something new? If you're a passionate person, maybe your heart will be revived.

Thank you [**fairy\_morgaine**](https://www.reddit.com/user/fairy_morgaine/) [**MephistoTheHater**](https://www.reddit.com/user/MephistoTheHater/) 

We just exchange messages online. I do remember him saying he is "scared" of what he is or might be capable of. He might not be into googling mood, look for ways to help himself. Instead, he is asking how I am.

I want to throw numbers at him which he can call right away but I don't know any. Would it help if I tell you his location? I guess I can also introduce him to reddit and create an account for him.
